english.note: Use this colloquial expression when worry leaves your mind unsettled or keeps returning to the same concern.

examples.english: I was worried all evening because I hadn't handed in the report.
examples.traditional: 份報告未交，我成晚都心掛掛。
examples.jyutping: fan6 bou3 gou3 mei6 gaau1 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 sam1 gwaa3 gwaa3
